issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath §6.4.2 in / §6.4.3 contains (multi-item singleton operand must throw)
issues.evidence: fhir4ds/fhirpath/duckdb/operators.py membership()/contains() helpers returned empty FHIRPathCollection for multi-item singleton operands instead of raising FHIRPathError; core engine (collections.py L354/365) and native evaluator.cpp (L9217/9231) raise. Reproducer: membership(FHIRPathCollection([1,2]), FHIRPathCollection([1,2,3])) -> {} (expected FHIRPathError). 12th instance of 'exported helper API forgotten' family.
issues.root_cause: Helper duplicated operator semantics with lenient error swallowing instead of mirroring engine singleton-violation errors
issues.resolution: operators.py membership/contains now raise FHIRPathError with the exact engine messages; regression test added in test_collection_operator_parity.py::test_membership_helper_singleton_violations_raise_fhirpath_error; unit tests 12/12 file, conformance 2832/2832.
